content.value_statement: Building reusable AI skills is hard when structure and scope are unclear. This skill guides users through examples, resources, authoring, packaging, and iteration.
actual_capabilities: Explains what AI skills are and which resources they can include.
Guides users through concrete examples before implementation starts.
Helps plan scripts, references, and assets for repeatable workflows.
Provides steps for initializing, editing, packaging, and iterating on skills.
Describes metadata, frontmatter, and writing style requirements for SKILL.md.
limitations: This package does not include the referenced init or packaging scripts.
It does not automatically validate a finished skill.
It works best when users provide concrete examples or domain knowledge.
It focuses on Claude-style skill packages, so other formats may need changes.

use_cases.title: Create a New Skill
use_cases.description: Plan a skill from user examples, then define metadata, resources, and authoring steps.

use_cases.title: Document Repeatable Workflows
use_cases.description: Turn repeated team procedures into reusable instructions with references, scripts, or assets.

use_cases.title: Improve an Existing Skill
use_cases.description: Review an existing skill, remove unused resources, clarify triggers, and plan packaging steps.

prompt_templates.title: Draft a Simple Skill
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner skill creation from one workflow.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a new skill for this workflow: [describe workflow]. Ask for missing examples, then draft the purpose, trigger description, and core instructions.

prompt_templates.title: Plan Reusable Resources
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze these example requests: [paste examples]. Identify which scripts, references, and assets would make the skill reusable and reliable.

prompt_templates.title: Improve a Skill Draft
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced revision of an existing skill.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this SKILL.md draft: [paste content]. Improve the metadata, remove vague instructions, and suggest any needed resource files.

prompt_templates.title: Package a Complete Skill
prompt_templates.prompt: Help prepare this skill for packaging: [describe files]. Check the structure, validation risks, unused resources, and iteration plan.

output_examples.input: Create a skill for rotating PDF pages.
output_examples.output: A PDF editor skill plan with a narrow trigger, a reusable rotation helper, and clear packaging steps.

output_examples.input: Improve this team policy skill before sharing it.
output_examples.output: A revised skill outline with clearer metadata, shorter core instructions, and policy details moved into references.

output_examples.input: Package a skill that creates branded presentations.
output_examples.output: A packaging checklist covering required metadata, retained assets, removed examples, and final validation steps.

best_practices: Start with concrete user examples before writing reusable instructions.
Keep SKILL.md lean and move detailed reference material into separate files.
Remove unused generated resources before packaging or sharing the skill.
anti_patterns: Using broad metadata that makes the skill trigger too often.
Placing long reference material in SKILL.md when separate files are clearer.
Shipping generated example files that the final skill does not use.

faq.question: What does this skill help create?
faq.answer: It helps create reusable AI skills with clear metadata, instructions, resources, packaging steps, and iteration practices.

faq.question: Does it write every resource file automatically?
faq.answer: No. It guides resource planning, but users still need to provide domain details, assets, or implementation requirements.

faq.question: Can it improve an existing skill?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes guidance for reviewing triggers, resources, writing style, packaging, and later iteration.

faq.question: Does this package include helper scripts?
faq.answer: No. The reviewed package contains only SKILL.md, and its script references are documentation examples.

faq.question: Which tools can use this skill?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: What should users prepare before using it?
faq.answer: Users should prepare concrete examples, expected triggers, resource needs, and any domain knowledge the skill must preserve.
